Debloat record — 192.168.0.99 (SkyworthDigital UHD Google TV STB, Android 14)

Tool: debloat.py   Undo everything: python debloat.py --restore

Method: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 <pkg>
This disables the package for user 0. It is reversible and does not delete APK
files or data, so partition contents and firmware are untouched.

Result: 19 packages disabled by this run, 24 disabled in total on the device.
Verified after a full reboot: boot_completed=1, launcher resolves to
com.spocky.projengmenu, GMS running, com.oemservice has no process.

The malware finding
  com.oemservice  (label "xcpe", version 1.2.1, /system/priv-app/app_xcpe_preset)
    Disabled and confirmed stopped. This is the XCPE package indicator GlassGuard
    flagged. Disabling stops the app from running but the APK is still present in
    the system partition and the firmware could re-enable it. It is not removal.

Retail and QA clutter
  com.sdt.producttest      factory product test
  com.oem.qa               OEM QA harness
  com.sdt.demo.control     retail demo control

Media preinstalls
  com.google.android.youtube.tvmusic
  com.google.android.apps.mediashell
  com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom  (was already disabled)

Backup and provisioning leftovers
  com.android.backupconfirm
  com.android.sharedstoragebackup
  com.android.wallpaperbackup
  com.google.android.partnersetup
  com.google.android.onetimeinitializer
  com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith  (was already disabled)

Screensavers and feedback
  com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx
  com.android.dreams.basic
  com.google.android.feedback
  com.android.tv.feedbackconsent

Calendar, print, games
  com.android.providers.calendar
  com.google.android.syncadapters.calendar
  com.android.printspooler
  com.google.android.play.games

Never touched (protected set in debloat.py): the launcher, keyboard, WebView,
GMS/GSF, Play Store, systemui, tv.settings, permissioncontroller, networkstack,
Bluetooth, package installers, and every vendor package (com.sdt.*, com.realtek.*,
com.rtk.*) that carries display, remote-control, front-panel or OTA function.

Verified working after the debloat
- TV rebooted cleanly and reached the home launcher.
- GlassGuard 1.4.1 launches and completes a scan of 143 packages.
- Its finding detail now reads "Status: dinyahaktifkan" for com.oemservice,
  read back from PackageManager rather than assumed.

Honest limits
- Disabling is not removal. The APK remains in /system/priv-app and firmware can
  re-enable it, especially across an OTA update.
- A factory reset re-enables everything recorded here.
- Disabling a vendor service that this list protects would risk a box that boots
  to a black screen; do not add to the candidate list without a working recovery.
- adb over TCP 5555 is still enabled with USB debugging authorised. Turn debugging
  off when finished, and never expose port 5555 to the internet.
